keys.table.name: Name
keys.table.keyTooltip: The full key is shown only once at creation; this list stores just the prefix and cannot copy it again. Delete the key and create a new one if it was lost
keys.table.costUsageTooltip: Counts only billable calls; BYOK keys do not consume quota
keys.table.strategyTooltip: Channel scoring by price / speed / stability / quality; empty follows global default
keys.createModal.title: Create API key
keys.editModal.title: Edit API key
keys.form.name: Name
keys.form.costLimit: Cost quota USD (empty = unlimited; billable calls only, BYOK excluded)
keys.form.strategyTooltip: Scores channels by price, response speed, stability and answer quality
keys.form.models: Model allowlist (empty = unlimited; type any model name and press Enter)

keys.form.channelsExtra: Routing is restricted to the selected channels; group/sharing visibility still applies, so invisible channels never take effect
keys.createdModal.title: API key created
keys.createdModal.warning: Save this key now — the plaintext is shown only here, once, and cannot be retrieved after you close this dialog
keys.testModal.title: Test connectivity: {{name}}
keys.testModal.help: Picks a channel from this key's visible channels and model whitelist and sends one minimal upstream probe. No charge, no usage, no request log.
keys.testModal.noModel: No testable model for this key (check channels and model whitelist)
keys.docs.title: Integration guide
keys.docs.keyHint: Replace sk-xxxxxxxx in the examples below with your own key (the plaintext is shown only once at creation)
keys.docs.baseUrlLabel: OpenAI-compatible base URL (use this in the OpenAI SDK)
keys.docs.sdkNote: The OpenAI SDK appends /chat/completions, so its base URL must include /v1; the Anthropic SDK appends /v1/messages, so its base URL must omit /v1.
